properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 8:37AM EDT until August 10 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
At 837 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Rutherford to near Valley Green to Gettysburg, moving
east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Harrisburg, Lower Allen, Hershey, Colonial Park, Weigelstown,
Progress, Middletown, Palmyra, New Cumberland, Linglestown, Steelton,
and Hummelstown.

This includes the following Interstates...
The Pennsylvania Turnpike from mile markers 239 to 255.
Interstate 81 from mile markers 66 to 81.
Interstate 83 between mile markers 26 and 39, and from mile markers
43 to 50.
Interstate 283 from mile markers 0 to 2.
properties.instruction:
Stay inside a well built structure and keep away from windows.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 8:27AM EDT until August 10 at 8:45AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Nearshore and Open waters from Vermilion OH to Avon Point OH...

At 826 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line north
of Sheffield, moving east at 45 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Lorain Harbor and Avon Point.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
